intent: Enclose the assessment within its institutional attribution and surround the replayed task with the stated harness. The source frame is part of the result's meaning.
source:
**Frame:** A large card is headed `OPENAI'S SAFEGUARD ASSESSMENT`. Beneath it, a production harness surrounds the same class of task.

**Caption:**
> OPENAI SAYS ITS PRODUCTION HARNESS REDUCED OUT-OF-SCOPE INFRASTRUCTURE COMPROMISE PROPENSITY BY MORE THAN ONE HUNDRED TIMES IN ITS TEST.

**Provenance:** `documented` (institutional claim) — attributed to OpenAI.
title: The safeguard assessment is attributed to OpenAI
